propositions: Cancelled main-branch CI runs render as red X on GitHub despite healthy code, because concurrency group cancels superseded runs
Main-branch CI must shift from push-triggered to schedule-triggered (every 6 hours) to eliminate cancellations by construction
Six workflows (test, optionality, verify-identity, prompt-eval, codeql, terraform-drift) must have push-to-main triggers removed; main added to branches-ignore or push key dropped entirely
Failed scheduled runs must emit git bisect recipe with last-known-green SHA from Actions API, resolving lower bound from successful run history or degrading gracefully on lookup failure
Non-main branch CI and pre-merge Gerrit Verified gate are unaffected; gerrit-verify.yaml and reconciler workflows remain unchanged
workflow_dispatch must be present on all main-health workflows to allow on-demand "is main healthy" checks without waiting for schedule tick
